findings.text: the flux-loops SVG is 601998 bytes, the largest committed artifact (the other two are 409655 and 415512); the gained commits cut each to 12-24% of its former size through render_to_bytes decimation and the plan mandates the SVGs under docs/figures/, so this is a follow-on for further decimation rather than a scope breach.

_UNITS_ATTR = 'units' remains a local redeclaration of imas_ambix/data/eddb.py:53 UNIT_ATTR, which eddb exports in __all__; the script could import the one owner instead of naming the attribute twice.

_flux_loop_indices still walks the raw Zarr group (store[category].array_keys(), the _time suffix) to enumerate cached flux loops instead of the eddb.py layout owners, so the cache layout stays known in two places; unchanged by the gained commits.

item_verdicts.call_sites: the only production callers of read_channel remain scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:_bound_panel and _flux_panel; the test file is not a production call site.
item_verdicts.diff: read commits a6643502, 34bdc65d and 8da01d86 against base 2aecdec7; imas_ambix/data/eddb.py:310 adds a guard that refuses a time base whose length differs from the data width, tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py adds the refusal test, scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py swaps label for ylabel and figure.savefig for imas_ink.io.render_to_bytes, and the three SVGs shrink to 409655, 601998 and 415512 bytes.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when names pytest tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py and the ruff command; the reviewed manifest records 32 passed (0 added failures) and ruff exit 0, and logs/figures_render.log prints the per-figure channel names/units and time-base differences.
item_verdicts.goal: the gained commits refine the §3 cached-pulse signal figures toward the plan's legibility and resolution requirements — labels move from the served semantic_id to the EDDB channel drawn, and figures render through imas_ink.io.render_to_bytes — rather than adding new capability.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; head 8da01d86, baseline_suite 7e975e9c 30 passed exit 0, after_suite 8da01d86 32 passed exit 0, zero failures both, negative_control_log reddens test_read_channel_round_trips_data_time_base_and_unit.
item_verdicts.write_paths: all seven paths in the incremental diff 2aecdec7..8da01d86 sit inside the reviewed manifest's declared write paths.

justifications.durability: the new half-written guard is exercised by tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py:test_read_channel_refuses_a_time_base_mismatched_with_the_data, which fails with DID NOT RAISE when the guard is removed, so the guard is guarded; the figures script still has no test covering its rendered output.
justifications.evidence: the reviewed manifest records pytest tests/data/test_eddb_cache.py 32 passed at 8da01d86 against 30 passed at base 7e975e9c, ruff exit 0 at both, and logs/figures_render.log; I independently reproduced 32 passed, ruff exit 0, zero 'legend' and one 'Time [s]' per SVG, byte sizes 409655/601998/415512, and falsified the new guard by removing it (1 failed, DID NOT RAISE).
justifications.fit: the gained change reuses imas-ink's TimeSeries.ylabel and io.render_to_bytes as the library intends, but scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:45 still redeclares _UNITS_ATTR = 'units' rather than importing the module's exported UNIT_ATTR.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:_bound_panel labels each panel's y-axis from the EDDB channel (rule.source_array) with its unit instead of the longer semantic_id, dropping the legend, and _render writes through imas_ink.io.render_to_bytes so the paths are decimated to display resolution, exactly the legibility and resolution the plan section requires.
justifications.reuse: no gained definition duplicates an existing capability; scripts/figures_jt60sa_signals.py:_flux_loop_indices still re-derives the Zarr channel layout its channel_path/time_array_name own, unchanged by these commits.
justifications.scope_discipline: every one of the seven paths in the 2aecdec7..8da01d86 diff sits inside the reviewed manifest's declared write paths and the section's remit; the flux-loops SVG is 601998 bytes, the largest committed artifact, but the plan mandates the SVGs under docs/figures/ and the gained commits cut them to 12-24% of their former size.
